plain_text:
Raymond Burr appears in 108 recordings across 16 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1949 to 1958. The credits here include performer, narrator, and announcer.

In this archive, you will hear Raymond Burr most often in Fort Laramie, Dragnet, Pat Novak, for Hire, Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Screen Directors Playhouse, The Line Up, CBS Radio Workshop, and Suspense.

Characters credited here include Captain Lee Quince and Inspector Hellman.
